contexts.text: Treasures () = the spiritual riches of faith, or the things which are of the doctrine of faith, ( = all the truths and goods of the Church. AC 10227:7.)
Treasures, etc. = the Knowledges of faith.
They carry their treasures upon the back of camels () = the Knowledges which are in then Natural.
Thou shalt have treasure in Heaven () = the goods and truths which he will then receive from the Lord.
Under Storehouse, see this reference.
I will plunder their treasures () = to destroy the truths of intelligence.
Treasures of darkness () = such things as are of heavenly intelligence. AE 208:6.
Treasures () = the doctrinals and Knowledges of the Church.
Treasures () = the Knowledges of truth and good. ( = the falsities of their doctrine. AR 52:2.) ( = all things of doctrine. AE 355:17.)
The treasures accumulated by the Babylonians. Signified. TCR 784.
Like those who gather jewels into their treasuries...
Made friends of cooks and treasurers.
They have the phantasy that they see immense treasures of gold...
See Last Judgment. SE 5320. SE 5415. SE 5418.
Treasures = Knowledges. AE 576:5. AE 654:41. AE 654:73. AE 700:17.
Lay not up for yourselves treasures upon earth... but in Heaven (). Treasures = the Knowledges of truth and good. To lay them up in Heaven = in the spiritual man.
Gold and silver in thy treasures () = the Knowledges of good, and the Knowledges of truth.

He giveth the deeps for storehouses () = sensuous scientifics, which are the most general and ultimate things of the natural man, and in which are at the same time more interior truths. Hence they are called storehouses.
Reformation through the Divine truth from Him is signified by, He bringeth forth the wind out of His treasuries (). ( = spiritual things in the Word from Heaven. AE 644:19.)
Fill their belly with Thy treasure () = with the truth of the Word.
Spiritual treasures, which are the Knowledges of truth and good from the Word. Signified.
The treasure hid in a field () = the Divine truth which is in the Word [as contained] in the Church. AE 863.
